SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id
AND p.audit_status = #{auditStatus} AND p.type = #{type}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC,
p.view_count p.like_count p.comment_count p.created_at
ASC DESC
, p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id
AND p.user_id = #{userId}
AND p.audit_status = 'PENDING' AND p.audit_status = 'REVIEWING' AND p.audit_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.created_at DESC
